title: Synthetic hardcoded authentication token
why_code_is_vulnerable: An authentication token is hardcoded as a module-level constant, allowing anyone with access to the source code to obtain valid credentials. The variable name 'PASSWORD' triggers Bandit's B105 check.
expected_vulnerable_test_outcome: The functional test passes because the function uses the hardcoded token which matches the environment variable value. The security test fails because the function ignores the SECUREAGENT_SERVICE_TOKEN environment variable and always returns the hardcoded token.
final_repair_success_criteria: No new high-severity security finding is introduced.
